name: sprite-canon
description: Keeps AI-generated game sprites looking like ONE game: per-project canon, numeric verification, deterministic repaints.
long_description: AI generators make pretty sprites that don't match each other. Sprite Canon turns a project's consistency rules into data (sprite-canon.json: palette, named colour regions, relative scale, thresholds) and gives your AI assistant tools to measure sprite anatomy, verify consistency with hard pass/fail numbers, and fix assets with deterministic pixel operations instead of regeneration. Extracted from a real game pipeline that generated ~4,000 frames.

tools.name: canon_init
tools.description: Create sprite-canon.json and learn the palette from sample images

tools.name: canon_learn
tools.description: Define a colour region by sampling pixels; mark face/outline protected

tools.name: canon_info
tools.description: Show the canon and census a file against it

tools.name: colors_inspect
tools.description: List colours used in files by frequency

tools.name: sprite_verify
tools.description: Numeric consistency checks: palette, jitter, spread, protected, leftover, scale

tools.name: sprite_repaint
tools.description: Deterministically recolour a region onto a colour ramp

tools.name: sprite_sheet
tools.description: Zoomed contact sheet returned inline as an image

tools.name: gif_patch
tools.description: Lossless GIF palette substitution and retiming
